headline: House rule that would have set up floor debate on four bills about federal regulations and gas stoves failed in a House vote.
what_it_does: This resolution would have set the House rules for debating and voting on four bills. Those bills dealt with requiring Congress to approve major agency rules, changing how courts review agency interpretations of laws and regulations, barring federal money from being used to ban gas stoves, and stopping a proposed Energy Department efficiency standard for home cooking products. The resolution itself would not have changed any law; it would only have allowed the House to take up those bills. It was voted down on June 6, 2023.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: They would have followed this resolution's procedures to debate and vote on the four bills.
